phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: Four days before the CBA expires, MLB sued the union in federal court to head off a legal challenge to its expected lockout, while the sides stay far apart on a salary cap.
latest: MLB and its 30 clubs sued the MLBPA and eight player leaders in Manhattan federal court, seeking a ruling that a lockout is legal; the union called the suit frivolous. MLB also dropped its escrow idea in favor of adjusting the cap in later years, which the union says takes the same money.
